summary: 22nd Century Group filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register the offer and sale of up to $6.4 million of its common stock through an at-the-market offering via Needham & Company as sales agent. No specific price, premium, or closing date is given; shares will be sold from time to time at prevailing market prices ($1.56 closing on April 30, 2026). The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special-situation event. It includes a risk factors section and a limit on sales under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3.
